title: Check Wi-Fi interface status and statistics
summary: Use iwconfig to see the current status, signal strength, and statistics of your wireless network interfaces. This helps you verify if your Wi-Fi card is active and connected.

steps.explain: Run iwconfig without arguments to list all wireless interfaces and their current parameters, including ESSID, mode, and signal quality.
To see details for a specific interface (like wlan0), add its name to the command.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the wireless interface, e.g., wlan0
